_help: Verified token unlocks and catalysts for the Early 2x Movers screen. Only entries with an https source count. Dates are YYYY-MM-DD. unlocks: a scheduled unlock (percentOfCirculating = size as % of circulating supply; 2%+ within 30 days is flagged and blocks high priority). unlockChecks: the date you checked a token's unlock schedule and found no major unlock in the next 30 days (worth tokenomics points for 30 days). catalysts: a dated, sourced event (counts from 7 days before to 42 days after). Example entries: {"symbol": "ABC", "date": "2026-11-20", "percentOfCirculating": 3.5, "source": "https://..."} · {"symbol": "ABC", "checkedOn": "2026-10-28", "source": "https://..."} · {"symbol": "ABC", "date": "2026-11-05", "title": "Mainnet launch", "source": "https://..."}
